text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. This time, I managed to hold on 
without falling!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"It must be because I got a good rest 
yesterday. Thank you so much~~"

text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have recovered enough 
stamina to stand firmly on her own feet 
again.
